prompt: Draft by position: pick your griller, your storyteller, and the one who brings the cooler. One American each.
response:
With the first three picks in the Ultimate Backyard Barbecue Draft, here is the roster:

**Round 1: The Griller — Guy Fieri**
You don’t mess around with your first-round pick: you draft the Mayor of Flavortown. Guy isn't just a meme; he is a legitimately trained chef who respects the art of the barbecue. He brings an arsenal of custom rubs, high-octane energy, and a pair of tongs that he clicks exactly twice before flipping a perfectly seared ribeye. He’s going to command the patio, loudly narrate his searing technique, and make sure nobody leaves hungry. Plus, he's definitely bringing his own proprietary barbecue sauce. 

**Round 2: The Storyteller — Matthew McConaughey**
When everyone has a plate of food and the sun starts going down, you need someone who can hold court. McConaughey is the undisputed champion of the rambling, profound, vaguely unbelievable life story. With a slow Texas drawl and a lot of wild hand gestures, he’ll launch into a mesmerizing tale about a three-day bongo-playing stint in the Amazon rainforest or a philosophical revelation he had while driving a Lincoln through the desert. You won't know if half of it is true, but you will be hanging onto every single word. Alright, alright, alright. 

**Round 3: The One Who Brings the Cooler — Bill Murray**
The “Cooler-Bringer” needs to be generous, reliable, and possess an immaculate sense of vibes. Bill Murray is the ultimate backyard wildcard. He’s showing up unannounced through the side gate hauling a massive, vintage Yeti cooler. You open it up, and it’s a chaotic but perfect masterpiece: a mix of high-end craft IPAs, cheap domestic tallboys, incredibly specific imported tequila, and somehow, perfectly chilled artisanal popsicles. He won't make a big deal out of it; he'll just hand you a frosty beverage, grab a hot dog, and casually crash your wiffle ball game.
